Project structure:

Set up and verified:

- **`pom.xml`** — Maven Central deps for `lombok` (1.18.48, `provided` scope) and `junit-jupiter` (6.1.3, test scope), with the compiler plugin wired to Lombok's annotation processor.
- **`src/main/java/com/example/model/User.java`** — a Lombok `@Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor` model, replacing hand-written getters/setters/constructors/`equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`.
- **`src/main/java/com/example/App.java`** — sample usage.
- **`src/test/java/com/example/UserTest.java`** — verifies the generated getters/setters/constructor/`equals`.
- **`.gitignore`** for `target/` and IDE files.

Confirmed with `mvn compile`, `mvn test`, and `mvn exec:java` that Lombok generates working code end to end.
